title: the plan migration leaves every terminal ticket
intention: The plan migration selects only tickets still in flight: a ticket whose cursor stands at a terminal is never opened for write. The terminal set is the class definition's (path ends plus dispositions) united with the grammar's TERMINAL_STATES.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: plan_migration._proved called a ticket open whenever its workflow lacked '[PROVED]'. On the house commons that selected 264 tickets, 52 of them at a terminal cursor (38 SUPERSEDED, 11 RETIRED, 3 DROPPED). akienasus's dry run over its commons would have rewritten 26 terminal tickets (21 SUPERSEDED, 2 RETIRED, 3 DROPPED). A terminal ticket's plan is a record of a finished voyage, not work to migrate.
traces_to: Law 5: a finished voyage's record is not rewritten. Law 1: the terminal set is read from the class, not kept as a second hardcoded list.
how: In cairn/machines/rehearsal/plan_migration.py, _proved becomes _terminal: parse the ticket's workflow (parse_workflow), load its class with transitions.load_class_def(root=<root>/node_classes), and treat the last state of each workflow version plus the class's dispositions, united with workflow_grammar.TERMINAL_STATES, as terminal. A class with no definition refuses the run. aa3e's proof world copies the live node_classes in, as a real commons carries them.

clauses.claim: a scratch commons with one code-seam ticket each at PROVED, SUPERSEDED, RETIRED, DROPPED, KILLED and ABSORBED plus one at BUILDME selects only the BUILDME ticket, dry and live, and every terminal ticket's files are byte-identical after the live run
a scratch class's own path end is terminal (its ticket is left alone), while a state neither the class nor the grammar calls terminal is selected
a ticket whose class has no definition under the commons refuses the run, naming the class

decisions.text: D1: migrate's selector reads each class's terminal set (path ends plus dispositions) from <root>/node_classes, united with workflow_grammar.TERMINAL_STATES.
D2: a red-first proof in a scratch commons, one tooth per clause.
D3: aa3e's proof world copies the live node_classes in.
